question: Interest payment on debt incurred by the government is part of the _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Revenue expenditure**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Interest payment on debt incurred by the government** is classified as **Revenue expenditure**. This is because it does not create any asset nor reduce any liability for the government. 
• **Revenue expenditure** refers to expenditures incurred by the government for its day-to-day functioning and operations, including interest payments on loans, salaries, subsidies, and grants. 
• Such expenditures are recurring in nature and are meant to ensure the smooth running of government services rather than creating or acquiring long-term assets.
